Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1462
Claimant:
Melissa Hawkins
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
2025-07-01
Insured reported a sideswipe during a lane change. The insured's policy is active and the driver listed on the policy is
the person who was operating the vehicle at the time.
2025-08-10
Claimant has retained an attorney, who has asked that all communication go through their office. Claimant's account
of the collision has remained the same in every conversation so far.
2025-08-22
Photos submitted with the file confirm several details of the contact point and the vehicle positions. There are no
independent witnesses to the lane change itself.
2025-10-04
Damage to both vehicles is mostly consistent with the described impact. A few older scratches near the rear quarter
panel may predate this loss and have been noted separately.
2025-11-05
Responding officer's report and statements from witnesses indicate the claimant was not inside the vehicle when the
collision occurred. This conflicts with the claimant's own description and needs to be reconciled before any payment
decision.
2025-11-08
Claimant reports a back strain from the collision. Medical records show a treatment course that ran somewhat longer
than is typical for this type of injury, and no prior injury to the same area has come up in the records reviewed so far.
2025-11-10
The impact appears to have been very light, which makes the severity of the claimed injury difficult to match to the
physical damage. Nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred before the coverage start date.
2026-01-05
Referred the file to the claims review group for a second look at the injury causation and the conflicting statements
about the claimant's location. Attorney has been notified that the claim is under further review and that a decision will
follow once that review is complete.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
